article.title: Motom公布Opportunities，把創作者活動接到品牌自營店面
article.summary: Motom公布創作者活動模組，讓品牌在自有計劃管理付費及送贈品合作。
highlights: 可參考創作者內容、過往銷售及計劃參與度選人。
公司指首階段計劃面向現有客戶。
article.why: 零售商可把創作者合作的邀約、到店及成交數據串起來，並分開檢視付費與自然銷售。
article.next_step: 為同一商品設定清楚的創作者連結與歸因窗口，比對自營店面記錄和訂單。
article.detail: Motom表示，品牌和零售商可在管理平台向創作者提出合作，並將活動流量帶到其網站上的創作者店面。模組涵蓋付費與贈品合作，可比較相關付費及自然銷售。公告列出先向現有客戶開放的安排。試行時可統一訂單歸因及退款口徑，再比較不同創作者。報表亦可按合作類型分開檢視。
article.title_en: Motom announces Opportunities to link creator campaigns with owned storefronts
article.summary_en: Motom announced a module that lets brands manage paid and gifting collaborations inside their own creator programmes.
highlights_en: Teams can select creators using content, sales history and programme activity.
The company plans to open initial access to existing customers.
article.why_en: Retailers can connect outreach, storefront visits and orders while tracking paid and organic sales separately.
article.next_step_en: Assign creator links and attribution windows for one product, then reconcile storefront records with orders.
article.detail_en: Motom says brands and retailers can offer collaborations in the admin portal and send campaign traffic to creator storefronts on their own sites. The module covers paid and gifting campaigns and supports comparing paid and organic sales. Existing clients are listed for initial access. Align attribution and refunds before comparing creators. Reports can also be reviewed by collaboration type.
